title: Wikidata Search Traces: A Dataset for Training Knowledge Graph Search Agents
title_zh: Wikidata 搜索轨迹：用于训练知识图谱搜索智能体的数据集
abstract_en: Wikidata is one of the largest open knowledge bases, yet answering a complex question over it still requires a SPARQL query that names the right entities and properties and chains their relations. Language models offer a natural-language alternative but answer largely from memory, which is least reliable for less prominent entities. We study agents that instead answer by exploring the graph, and argue that two obstacles limit them: the lack of training data recording how a solver explores, and interfaces that add large graph results directly to the model's context. We test three hypotheses: that the difficulty of graph search can be controlled through the structure of a question rather than only through obscure entities or wording; that much of the failure on long-horizon search comes from how retrieved evidence is managed rather than from the model itself; and that, in a suitable environment, open-weight models can match commercial closed ones. We construct multi-hop questions on a frozen Wikidata snapshot by replacing named entities with nested conditions, checking after each expansion that the target remains unique and that every new condition is necessary. We release 10,235 solving traces over single-entity and multi-hop questions, together with the recursive language model (RLM) harness that produced them, in which models batch graph calls, keep results in persistent Python state and interpret selected evidence through sub-calls. On 100 questions, the harness improves both models we ran under both interfaces compared with direct tool calling over the same functions: gpt-6-luna rises from 49 to 61 correct answers, doubling its multi-hop accuracy, and Qwen3.8-27B, an open-weight model served on a single GPU, from 60 to 74.
abstract_zh: 论文研究如何让智能体通过探索 Wikidata 知识图谱回答复杂问题，而非仅依赖语言模型记忆。作者指出，现有方法受两方面限制：缺乏记录搜索过程的训练数据，以及将大量图谱结果直接塞入模型上下文的低效接口。研究提出三项假设：问题结构可以控制图搜索难度；长程搜索失败很大程度源于证据管理方式；在合适环境下，开放权重模型能够达到闭源模型水平。作者基于冻结的 Wikidata 快照构造单实体和多跳问题，通过嵌套条件替换实体，并验证目标唯一性及每个条件的必要性，发布包含 10,235 条求解轨迹的数据集。同时提出 recursive language model（RLM）框架，使模型能够批量调用图谱接口、将结果保存在持久化 Python 状态中，并通过子调用解析选定证据。在 100 道题上的实验中，RLM 相比直接工具调用显著提升性能：gpt-6-luna 从 49 题提升至 61 题，且多跳准确率翻倍；单 GPU 部署的开放权重模型 Qwen3.8-27B 从 60 题提升至 74 题。
key_points_zh: 发布 10,235 条 Wikidata 单实体与多跳问题求解轨迹，弥补知识图谱搜索智能体训练数据不足。
通过嵌套条件控制问题结构与搜索难度，并确保答案唯一且每个条件都不可省略。
提出 recursive language model（RLM）环境：批量调用图谱、持久化保存结果，并用子调用选择性解析证据。
实验表明，证据管理和交互接口是长程搜索成败的关键，而不只是模型本身能力。
RLM 同时提升 gpt-6-luna 与 Qwen3.8-27B 的表现，说明开放权重模型在合适环境下可接近或超过闭源模型。

llm_assessment.comment: This paper releases valuable search-agent trajectories alongside a persistent-state harness that directly supports training and evaluation of long-horizon graph search.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 论文发布了有价值的搜索智能体轨迹数据及持久状态框架，直接支持长时知识图谱搜索的训练与评测。
